description:
HiQPdf Next HTML to PDF Converter for .NET (Multi-platform) uses a highly accurate and reliable rendering engine to process modern and complex HTML, CSS and JavaScript content in compliance with the latest standards.

The converter targets .NET Standard 2.0 and can be used in .NET Core and .NET Framework applications deployed on Windows, Linux and macOS platforms, including Azure App Service, Azure Functions and Docker.

This multi-platform metapackage installs the Windows x64 and Linux x64 runtimes.

For Windows ARM64, Linux ARM64 and macOS ARM64, the additional packages HiQPdf.Next.HtmlToPdf.Windows.Arm64, HiQPdf.Next.HtmlToPdf.Linux.Arm64 and HiQPdf.Next.HtmlToPdf.MacOS can be referenced on their own or alongside this package.

Compatibility:

* Windows 10, 11 and Windows Server 2016 to 2025 (x64)
* Linux (x64) - Debian 11+, Ubuntu 20.04+ or equivalent
* Windows, Linux and macOS (ARM64) - via additional packages
* .NET 10.0, 9.0, 8.0, 7.0, 6.0 and .NET Standard 2.0
* .NET Framework 4.6.2 to 4.8.1
* Azure App Service and Azure Functions
* Virtual Machines
* Docker containers
* Web, Console and Desktop applications

Main Features:

* Convert HTML with CSS, web fonts and JavaScript to PDF
* Support modern web standards and technologies
* Generate PDF/UA and PDF/A compliant documents
* Add HTML with page numbers in headers, footers and stamps
* Repeat HTML table headers and footers in PDF pages
* Control PDF page breaks with CSS in HTML
* Create outlines and tables of contents from heading tags
* Convert HTML forms to interactive PDF forms
* Convert or exclude specific HTML regions
* Retrieve HTML element positions in the PDF
* Trigger conversion automatically or manually
* Render for screen or print media
* Set PDF security, viewer settings and signatures
* Set HTTP headers and cookies
* Use GET and POST requests
* Convert HTML to images
* Convert SVG to PDF
* Asynchronous methods for async/await
